# nuxt-reviews

> Nuxt 4 module that fetches and aggregates reviews from Google Places, Trustpilot, SerpAPI, Outscraper, and Booking.com (beta) into a single normalized shape, with auto-injected Schema.org JSON-LD and a built-in component kit.

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/nuxt-reviews
- Repo: https://github.com/eralpozcan/nuxt-reviews
- Docs (full, consumer-facing): ./playground/content/ — auto-built at https://nuxt-reviews.netlify.app
- Install: `npx nuxi module add nuxt-reviews`
- Changelog: ./CHANGELOG.md
- Version: 0.1.4

## If you are integrating this into a Nuxt app

1. Install: `npx nuxi module add nuxt-reviews` (adds to `nuxt.config.ts` and installs the dep).
2. Configure providers under `runtimeConfig.reviews.providers` in `nuxt.config.ts`. Every provider's credentials stay server-side — never reference them in client code or `app.config`.
3. In any component, import the auto-imported composables:
   - `useReviews(options?)` — fetch reviews (aggregated or per-provider)
   - `useReviewSchema(reviews, aggregate, item)` — inject JSON-LD for Google rich snippets
4. Components `<ReviewStars>`, `<ReviewCard>`, `<ReviewList>`, `<ReviewSummary>` are auto-registered.
5. Server routes `GET /api/_reviews` (aggregate) and `GET /api/_reviews/:provider` (single) are unauthenticated by design — add your own Nitro middleware if you need to gate them.

## Providers

| Provider    | Required config                                | Auth        | Notes                         |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ----------------------------- |
| `google`    | `apiKey`, `placeId`                            | API key     | Google Places API             |
| `trustpilot`| `apiKey`, `businessUnitId`                     | API key     | Trustpilot Business API       |
| `serpapi`   | `apiKey`, `placeId`                            | API key     | Google reviews via SerpAPI    |
| `outscraper`| `apiKey`, `placeId`                            | API key     | Google reviews via Outscraper |
| `bookingcom`| `username`, `password`, `propertyId`           | Basic Auth  | Connectivity Partner API, BETA — only `https://supply-xml.booking.com/` URLs are followed for pagination |
| `mock`      | none                                           | none        | 12 fake reviews, 8 languages, for dev/test |

## Public composables

### `useReviews(options?)`

- `options.provider?: 'all' | 'google' | 'trustpilot' | 'serpapi' | 'outscraper' | 'bookingcom' | 'mock'` — default `'all'` (aggregated)
- `options.limit?: number` — max reviews to return
- `options.language?: string` — ISO language filter
- `options.sort?: string` — provider-specific
- `options.minRating?: number` — 1-5 floor
- `options.pageToken?: string` — pagination cursor for single-provider mode
- Returns `{ data, pending, error, refresh, aggregate, sources, fetchedAt, nextPageToken, totalAvailable }`
- `aggregate` is `{ average: number, total: number, distribution: Record<'1'|'2'|'3'|'4'|'5', number> }`

### `useReviewSchema(reviewsRef, aggregateRef, item)`

- Reviews and aggregate must be `Ref<...>` or `ComputedRef<...>`
- `item: { name: string, description?, url?, image?, type? }` — `type` defaults to `'LocalBusiness'`
- Emits a `<script type="application/ld+json">` block via `useHead` with up to 20 review entries
- Untrusted review text is automatically escaped (`<`, `>`, `&`) to prevent stored XSS

## Review shape (Schema.org-aligned)

```ts
{
  id: string                    // prefixed with provider name, e.g. "trustpilot_abc123"
  provider: string              // one of the keys above
  rating: number                // normalized to 1-5, half-steps allowed
  text: string
  title?: string
  author: { name: string, avatar?: string|null, url?: string|null }
  publishedAt: string           // ISO 8601
  language?: string             // ISO 639-1 (e.g. "en", "tr")
  isVerified?: boolean
  businessResponse?: { text: string, publishedAt: string }
  raw?: object                  // full upstream payload — use only for debugging
}
```

## Full configuration

```ts
// nuxt.config.ts
export default defineNuxtConfig({
  modules: ['nuxt-reviews'],
  runtimeConfig: {
    reviews: {
      providers: {
        google:     { apiKey: process.env.GOOGLE_API_KEY!,    placeId: 'ChIJ...' },
        trustpilot: { apiKey: process.env.TRUSTPILOT_API_KEY!, businessUnitId: '...' },
        serpapi:    { apiKey: process.env.SERPAPI_API_KEY!,    placeId: 'ChIJ...' },
        outscraper: { apiKey: process.env.OUTSCRAPER_API_KEY!, placeId: 'ChIJ...' },
        bookingcom: { username: process.env.BOOKINGCOM_USERNAME!, password: process.env.BOOKINGCOM_PASSWORD!, propertyId: '1234567890' },
      },
      maxReviews: 50,         // default 50
      minRating: undefined,   // global floor
      cache: true,            // default true
      cacheTTL: 3600,         // default 1h, seconds
      moderation: {
        enabled: false,
        provider: 'perspective',  // or 'openai'
        apiKey: '...',
        toxicityThreshold: 0.7,   // 0-1
        action: 'filter',         // or 'flag'
      },
    },
  },
})
```

## Component kit

Auto-imported, zero dependencies, scoped CSS, full TS props.

- `<ReviewStars :rating="4.5" :max="5" />` — display only
- `<ReviewCard :review="r" />` — single review block
- `<ReviewList :reviews="reviews" :aggregate="agg" />` — list with header
- `<ReviewSummary :aggregate="agg" :sources="sources" />` — average + distribution

## Layout (contributor reference)

```
src/
  module.ts                              # @nuxt/kit entry
  runtime/
    server/api/reviews/                  # injected Nitro routes
    server/utils/providers/              # one adapter per provider
    server/utils/aggregate.ts            # buildCollection, computeAverage
    server/utils/moderation.ts           # Perspective / OpenAI
    composables/                         # useReviews, useReviewSchema
    components/                          # ReviewStars / Card / List / Summary
    types/index.ts                       # public types
test/                                    # vitest + @nuxt/test-utils
playground/                              # demo app (separate package.json)
```

## Build & test (contributor reference)

- `pnpm install` — root deps
- `pnpm install` in `playground/` — playground deps
- `pnpm dev:prepare` — build stubs + types
- `pnpm dev` — start playground
- `pnpm test` — vitest (36 passing, 1 skipped — see test/basic.test.ts)
- `pnpm lint` — eslint
- `pnpm release` — full release (lint + test + build + changelogen + npm publish + git push)

## Common tasks

- "Add Google reviews" → set `runtimeConfig.reviews.providers.google.{apiKey, placeId}`. See `src/runtime/server/utils/providers/google.ts`.
- "Add another language filter" → `useReviews({ language: 'tr' })` — passed through to providers that support it.
- "Show stars only" → `<ReviewStars :rating="aggregate.average" />`.
- "Add JSON-LD for SEO" → call `useReviewSchema(reviews, aggregate, { name, url, image, description })` in your page setup.
- "Switch to dev data" → set `providers.mock: {}` and remove other providers.
- "Tune how many reviews" → `maxReviews` in config, or `limit` option per call.
